title: Token Listing Counsel
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Job Summary

This is full-time and on-site job in Vienna, Austria. As Token Listing Counsel, you will play a critical role in advising on legal, regulatory, and risk-related aspects of listing digital tokens on our platform. This includes conducting due diligence, managing risk assessments, and ensuring compliance with relevant laws and exchange policies. You will work cross-functionally with listing, compliance, business development, and product teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide legal advice and guidance on token listing matters, including regulatory classification, risk assessments, and jurisdictional considerations.
  • Review and assess token listing applications for compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead and coordinate token due diligence processes, including reviewing whitepapers, tokenomics, project structures, and legal opinions.
  • Liaise with external counsel and regulators (as necessary) to address legal risks and support exchange licensing.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate listing agreements and related documentation.
  • Monitor global regulatory developments relating to digital assets and advise on potential impact to listing activities.
  • Partner with internal teams (Compliance, BD, Risk, Product) to implement listing governance frameworks and procedures.
  • Assist in shaping internal listing policies, protocols, and risk matrices.
  • Support ongoing reviews or delistings of tokens based on evolving risks or compliance concerns.

Qualifications

  • A degree in law (JD, LLB, or equivalent) and eligibility to practice in at least one jurisdiction.
  • 4+ years of legal experience, preferably with exposure to fintech, blockchain, or digital assets.
  • Experience in regulatory compliance, financial markets, or digital token offerings is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of global crypto regulations, securities laws, and regulatory bodies (e.g., SEC, MiCA, MAS, etc.).
  • Excellent communication, legal writing, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, cross-border environment.

Preferred Skills

  • Prior experience working in a crypto exchange, law firm, or fintech company.
  • Familiarity with tokenomics, smart contracts, and decentralized protocols.
  • Multilingual capabilities a plus.

Why Join Us

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

Our benefits include:

  • Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
  • Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
  • Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
  • Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
  • Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
